comment: Central model registry for the bundle. SWE-2 native: routing is by effort level (Medium/High/Max), not model size. Install/export scripts may expand {{...}} placeholders. Env overrides: BUNDLE_DEFAULT_MODEL, BUNDLE_DEFAULT_SUBAGENT_MODEL, BUNDLE_MAX_MODEL, BUNDLE_MEDIUM_MODEL.

effort_levels.medium: Simple tasks, spot fixes, isolated scripts.
effort_levels.high: Tasks spanning multiple files; default for general work.
effort_levels.max: Open-ended tasks, global refactors, long-horizon coding.
effort_levels.advisor: Escalation consult role: strongest free model, invoked for hard decisions only (architecture, dead-end bugs).

models.name: SWE-2 Flash Medium
models.notes: SWE-2 Flash family (2026-11-04): post-train of Inkling-Small 276B/12B MoE (Apache-2.0). ~200 tok/s vs SWE-2 60; free in Devin Desktop+CLI. After the free window ends, 1/5 the price of SWE-2.

models.name: SWE-2 Flash High
models.notes: Flash variant at high effort - fast lane for routine multi-file work.

models.name: SWE-2 Flash Max
models.notes: Flash variant at max effort - cheap escalation while the free window lasts.
